name: omnimarkz
description: This plugin holds these OmniMarkz skills: design-file-to-wordpress, design-file-what-changed, design-file-social-image, design-file-slides, and design-file-to-canva. Each skill reads an InDesign, Publisher, QuarkXPress, or PDF file. Connect OmniMarkz on a Mac from OmniMarkz → Preferences → MCP, or on Windows from File → Settings… → MCP, before a skill can convert. The plugin is desktop-only and does not run in ChatGPT on the web.
